title: PLUS says information of four services, incl. JOINTEX, may have leaked via PLAID KARTE breach
what_changed: PLUS's own notice of 18 November was read and added as the primary source. It lists counts per service (smartschool 21,071, smart care 10,190, smartoffice 1,176, JOINTEX 42 items) and states no total, so the 32,479 total relayed from Cybersecurity.com was removed from the summary, plain and exec. Validation changed from single_source to corroborated (primary source).
